description:
Smith & Butler Estates are delighted to present this beautifully maintained home, ideally located in the mature and highly sought-after residential area of Ardmore in Artane.

The accommodation is wonderfully bright and well-proportioned throughout, starting on the ground floor with a welcoming entrance hallway that leads to a spacious front living room centred around a magnificent cast-iron open fireplace. To the rear, the open-plan dining area features a cosy stove and flows seamlessly into a kitchen equipped with classical country-white cabinetry and slate-grey tiled splashbacks. Accessible directly from this family hub is a massive, sun-drenched lounge extension illuminated by dual Velux skylights, providing a brilliant secondary social space with double French doors that open out to the garden. The ground floor is completed with a convenient bathroom. 

Up the stairs to the second floor, the layout comprises three well-proportioned bedrooms, two of which feature extensive floor-to-ceiling built-in wardrobe storage, alongside a contemporary family bathroom beautifully finished with elegant neutral wall-and-floor tiling and a bath shower combination. The third floor comprises an attic conversion nestled under characterful sloped ceilings, complete with its own dedicated en-suite shower room and convenient access to low-level eaves storage. Externally to the front, a secure gated and fully printed concrete driveway bordered by an elegant pillared porch canopy provides excellent off-street parking. To the rear, the low-maintenance, fully paved multi-tier courtyard garden features a raised sun terrace and a solid block-built storage shed, offering an ideal, highly private outdoor oasis for dining, relaxing, and entertaining.  

The location is second to none, with a wide range of amenities nearby including Artane Castle Shopping Centre, Beaumont Hospital, public parks such as Rockfield and St. Annes Park and Dublin City University. The area is well-served by excellent public transport links, with numerous bus routes providing easy access to Dublin City Centre, local DART stations such as Harmonstown and Killester also provide access to other parts of the city. While the M1, M50, and Dublin Airport are all within easy reach.
